FAQ

Got questions?

If it's not covered here, send us a message and we'll sort you out

Is this for beginners?

Yes. The 6 Week Reset comes in beginner, intermediate and advanced, and every exercise has a video demo so you're never guessing.

Do I need a gym?

The programs are built for the gym. If your gym doesn't have a certain machine, swap the exercise in one tap.

How do the meal plans work?

Your plan is built around your calorie and macro targets. Pick from multiple day options, swap any meal you don't fancy and generate a shopping list straight from the app.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Your plan renews automatically and you can cancel before your next billing date.

What phones does it work on?

The app is available on iPhone and Android. After checkout you'll get an email with your download link and login.
